2:3 vertical format, photorealistic minimalist bedroom body-detail photography. An adult female, clearly aged 22-28 years old, is lying sideways or semi-reclined on a gray-blue bed. The body forms a diagonal line across the frame, with the abdomen and waistline as the visual center. One arm is bent across the upper abdomen, while the other hand grasps the hem of a white top and gently lifts it upward, creating natural folds and revealing the waist, abdomen, and navel. The posture is relaxed and quiet, like a natural moment of just waking up in the morning, without exaggerated posing.

She wears a pure white tight-fitting short-sleeved T-shirt or thin knit top in a soft elastic fabric, creating fine stretch textures and realistic wrinkles across the chest and abdomen; lower garments are minimized and mostly outside the frame. Skin remains real and natural, with a slight softness and subtle skin tone variations in the abdomen; the navel is natural, not pursuing excessive thinness or plastic-like smoothness.

The environment is a minimalist bedroom, with the bed covered in a cold gray-blue quilted bedspread or cotton sheet, showing clear embossing, stitching, subtle folds, and body indentations. The background has no furniture or decorations, preserving only the material relationship between the fabric and the human body.

Lighting is cloudy morning window light entering from the upper right, forming cold blue-gray soft side lighting. Delicate highlights appear on the white top, with gentle gradients of light and shadow on the abdomen, arms, and waist side; shadows retain detail, no hard flash, no warm lights. 50mm or 85mm lens, f/2–2.8, ISO200–400, shallow depth of field, with clear textures on the abdomen, hands, and fabric; frame edges are slightly softened.
